ambiguities_or_notes: Confirmed source-layer omission: the audited Markdown and Tolstoy Digital TEI stop item 5 after ‘сыграв’ and an added ‘сыграть.’, whereas the official 90-volume electronic text on pp. 241–242 reads ‘сыграв[169] раза два неизвестныя ноты, стараться сыграть наизусть.’

Official textual note 169 reads ‘Написано: сыграть.’ The English restores the verified main-text continuation and represents note 169 as footnote [^1], while the Russian repository and its SHA-256 remain unchanged.

Tolstoy’s repeated conceptual triad ‘space, time, and force’ and rough labels such as ‘to hear from writing’ / ‘to write from playing’ are preserved rather than normalized into later music-theory terminology.
